title: Development Opportunity – Potential Townhouse Project Near Mijas Pueblo
summary: An attractive development opportunity on the Mijas Road, located just 7 minutes from Mijas Pueblo and Fuengirola, comprising a private plot of approximately 3,141 m² with an existing villa and two independent bungalows.
description:
An attractive development opportunity on the Mijas Road, located just 7 minutes from Mijas Pueblo and Fuengirola, comprising a private plot of approximately 3,141 m² with an existing villa and two independent bungalows.

The existing buildings offer the option of renovation; however, the property also presents an interesting opportunity for developers looking to redevelop the site as a residential project, subject to the necessary planning approvals and detailed project design.

The plot is classified under ADS-3 (Agrupación de Vivienda Unifamiliar Adosada – Subzona 3), with the following planning parameters:

Net buildability: 0.70 m²t/m²s

Maximum site coverage: 50%

Plot size: 3,141 m²

Approximate above-ground buildable area: 2,199 m²

Based on the permitted buildability, the theoretical development potential could accommodate approximately:

Average Unit SizeApproximate Number of Units

100 m²21–22

120 m²18

140 m²15–16

160 m²13–14

Allowing for the requirements of the final scheme — including internal access roads, parking, landscaping, refuse facilities, utilities, retaining structures, setbacks and other planning requirements — a development of approximately 14–18 townhouses may be achievable, subject to the final project design and confirmation by the relevant planning authorities.

The shape and dimensions of the plot appear well suited to this type of development, offering developers the possibility to create a boutique residential scheme in an established and highly accessible area.

The location is particularly attractive for the residential market, with Mijas Pueblo and Fuengirola both approximately seven minutes away, while the beaches, golf courses, international schools, amenities and wider Costa del Sol are all within easy reach.

For a developer, the site offers the opportunity to replace the existing dated property with a modern townhouse development in a well-connected location, potentially creating a scheme of approximately 14–18 homes depending on the final configuration.

A rare development opportunity combining a substantial plot, favourable planning parameters and an excellent location between Mijas Pueblo and Fuengirola.
